scope: Unit A of the common deployment experiment (handoff item 3): CE-1 (interface, secrecy commands, modes, transcript entries, logs, output, query classes and budgets with the fresh-message byte budget, public transcript functions phase, owner, NoBundleFailure and designate), CE-2 (secrecy layer with test and fresh, produced-frame log, mode P projection, frame lemmas), the CE-3 remainder (compile lemma for the complete experiment in both modes, re-check of the twelve trial modules over the extended interface, budget transport including the fresh-message byte budget and its closed form), CE-4 (generic exact target selection: split, event and advantage forms, plain and signed guessing combinators) and CE-5 (publicity of phase, owner, NoBundleFailure and designate as a run invariant, owner and KEM creation index in the annotated execution, designate_keymatch and the Beacon ciphertext link with the read-back laws, approved_goodkem and kernel_reads_unrevealed for the tagged compiled program).

plan.stages: CE-1, CE-2, CE-3 remainder, CE-4, CE-5

theorem compile_full_game (setup : Setup baseSpec KemSK) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (checks : Checks)
    (route : RawCtxServerRouting.SenderDecoder) (ensureInit : StateT A ProbComp Bool) (identityIndex : Nat)
    (phase1 : PqxdhServerAuthNegativeControl.Phase1ReadBack codec)
    (phase2 : PqxdhServerAuthNegativeControl.Phase2ReadBack codec)
    (bounds : FreshBounds) (mode : Mode) (adversary : OracleComp (ModeSpec mode) X) (runtime : A) :
    mergeFull <$> (PqxdhRegistrationJointInitializedSchedule.native setup codec checks ensureInit identityIndex none
        (compileFull setup codec route bounds mode adversary)).run runtime =
      (PqxdhDeploymentSecrecy.game setup codec checks route ensureInit identityIndex bounds mode adversary).run
        runtime

exact_statements.UniformTargetSelection.guess:
theorem guess [SampleableType G] (run : ProbComp Ω) (event : Ω → Prop) [DecidablePred event]
    (designate : Ω → Option G) (eligible : ∀ outcome, event outcome → designate outcome ≠ none) :
    𝒟[(fun outcome => decide (event outcome)) <$> run] {true} =
      (Fintype.card G : ℝ≥0∞) * 𝒟[(fun pair : G × Ω => decide (event pair.2 ∧ designate pair.2 = some pair.1)) <$> do
        let target ← $ᵗ G
        let outcome ← run
        pure (target, outcome)] {true}
exact_statements.UniformTargetSelection.advantage:
theorem advantage (run : ProbComp Ω) (correct : Ω → Prop) [DecidablePred correct] (designate : Ω → Option G) :
    (𝒟[(fun outcome => decide (correct outcome ∧ (designate outcome).isSome)) <$> run] {true}).toReal -
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (𝒟[(fun outcome => (designate outcome).isSome) <$> run] {true}).toReal =
      ∑ target, ((𝒟[(fun outcome => decide (correct outcome ∧ designate outcome = some target)) <$> run] {true}).toReal -
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (𝒟[(fun outcome => decide (designate outcome = some target)) <$> run] {true}).toReal)
exact_statements.UniformTargetSelection.signed:
theorem signed [SampleableType G] (left right : G → ProbComp Ω) (event : G → Ω → Prop)
    [∀ target, DecidablePred (event target)] :
    ∑ target, ((𝒟[(fun outcome => decide (event target outcome)) <$> left target] {true}).toReal -
        (𝒟[(fun outcome => decide (event target outcome)) <$> right target] {true}).toReal) =
      (Fintype.card G : ℝ) * ((𝒟[(fun pair : G × Ω => decide (event pair.1 pair.2)) <$> do
          let target ← $ᵗ G
          let outcome ← left target
          pure (target, outcome)] {true}).toReal -
        (𝒟[(fun pair : G × Ω => decide (event pair.1 pair.2)) <$> do
          let target ← $ᵗ G
          let outcome ← right target
          pure (target, outcome)] {true}).toReal)

exact_statements.PqxdhDeploymentKeyMatch.designate_keymat:
theorem designate_keymatch (setup : Setup baseSpec KemSK) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (checks : Checks)
    (phase1 : Phase1ReadBack codec) (server : RawCtxServerRouting.Identity) (serverKid : Std.U64)
    (transcript : List Entry) (native : PqxdhRegistrationSchedule.State KemSK)
    (agree : Agree setup codec server transcript native) (keyId : Std.U64) (session k : Nat)
    (designated : designate codec serverKid transcript (.peer keyId) = some (session, k)) (raw : Pqxdh.Bytes)
    (accepted : acceptOf transcript session = some raw) (value : PqxdhServerRootPreparation.Verified Reader)
    (verifiedRaw : PqxdhRegistrationJointRawSignatures.verified setup codec checks raw = some value) :
    PublishedKey setup codec transcript native k value.keys.pqKey ∧
      ∃ owner : PqxdhRegistrationSchedule.Owner KemSK, native.owners[k]? = some owner ∧
        value.candidate.identityKey = encodedIdentity (setup.joint.publicKeys owner.beacon.identity).ed25519
exact_statements.PqxdhDeploymentKeyMatch.owner_link:
theorem owner_link (setup : Setup baseSpec KemSK) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (checks : Checks)
    (phase1 : Phase1ReadBack codec) (phase2 : Phase2ReadBack codec) (server : RawCtxServerRouting.Identity)
    (serverKid : Std.U64) (transcript : List Entry) (native : PqxdhRegistrationSchedule.State KemSK)
    (agree : Agree setup codec server transcript native) (index session k : Nat)
    (designated : designate codec serverKid transcript (.owner index) = some (session, k)) :
    k = index ∧ ∃ (owner : PqxdhRegistrationSchedule.Owner KemSK) (response : PqxdhServerRegistrationPublication.Response)
      (fields : PqxdhServerRegistrationPublication.ResponseFields) (raw : Pqxdh.Bytes),
      native.owners[index]? = some owner ∧ phaseClass owner.beacon.phase = .established ∧
      pinnedKeyId owner.beacon.phase = serverKid ∧ owner.beacon.serverIdentity = server ∧
      buildOf transcript session = some response ∧ codec.write2 fields = some response.serialized ∧
      fields.identity = server ∧ finishOf transcript index = some raw ∧
      (codec.read2 raw).bind codec.ciphertext = some fields.kemCiphertext ∧
      ∀ accepted value, acceptOf transcript session = some accepted →
        PqxdhRegistrationJointRawSignatures.verified setup codec checks accepted = some value →
        PublishedKey setup codec transcript native index value.keys.pqKey

leanpath.note: The CE-3 trial LEAN_PATH with its first entry replaced by the fresh scratch prefix unit-a/olean, a symlink mirror of the 1534 trial artifacts (stage D artifacts plus the twelve trial deployment modules); check.py unlinks an artifact before writing it, so trial files were never written. Every module was rebuilt into unit-a/olean in import order.

focused_inventory_note: Each module commit was prepared with the other untracked files and other modified tracked files held aside and restored afterwards (commit.py), so check-inventory ran with exactly the files of that commit; the produced-frame commit carried six trial modules together. The documentation commit that adds this receipt is checked the same way.
forbidden_scan: zero matches of \b(sorry|admit|native_decide|implemented_by|extern|unsafe|opaque)\b outside guards and no axiom declaration in the 21 modules; the only set_option lines are autoImplicit false, linter.deprecated false (scoped by in, in UniformTargetSelection) and the pre-existing maxRecDepth options of the trial modules
deviations_from_plan: Secrecy commands and the transcript are a layer (ledgerImpl) over the trial native handler; the CE handler is the flattened composition, and the compiled program of a complete-interface adversary is the trial compiler applied to the wrapped adversary.

The produced-frame log required extending the trial record commands in place (State, Local, serverStep, beaconStep, serverLocal, beaconLocal, merge); no trial statement was weakened or deleted, statements mentioning these definitions changed accordingly, and three statements were added to trial modules (merge_produce, logged_bound and the logged lemmas in Native).

The transcript stores mode O replies; mode P views are projections. Publication and receipt are functions of the transcript. Produced frames are tagged with the producing command instead of (side, handle, seq).

A rejected test or fresh command is recorded in the transcript with its none reply; the fresh claim index is the position of the admitted fresh message; Claim has only the fresh-message claim (CE-RG not built).

qFreshBytes is ellmax times qFresh; the coin cap charges one coin per test; the BLAKE2b cap is qHash + S + R + qTest + qFresh (tests and fresh messages counted twice). Both looser than the plan, both sound.

designate compares raw candidate fields of the accept bytes and of the published bundle instead of RawSignatures.verified; the Beacon side checks the pin against the Server identity in the build response (adversary has no input, D5) and owner_link proves with Phase2ReadBack that it is the Server identity.

designate_keymatch is proved at the deployment level (the verified PQ key is the key the owner signed in its honest published bundle); the step to KeyMatchFinal in the annotated execution is CE-9 step 9.1. owner_kemIndex supplies the owner-to-KEM-index correspondence for it.
The router stays a free parameter; DecoderAgreement is not used by any unit A statement.
No planned statement turned out false or unprovable; none was weakened.
